notes.title: Bug fixes v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Bugfix on game over screen that causes buttons not to appear.
Adding sound effects for player death and stun, plus level success and failure.
Reloading game on reset progress bug fix.

notes.title: Bug fixes v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed undefined in game over screen
Fixed menu selection via keys/joystick with locked guards
Showing correct guard image in upgrade menu

notes.title: Game Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
We heard you, it's too hard, okay okay okay...

We made it easier on Normal and Hard difficulties.  We also:


 Fixed a bug with being able to upgrade when money was zero.
 Fixed menu navigation bug when buttons aren't visible (yet)
 Fixed mouseover states on game over screen
 A gameplay is only counted if you play for more than 30 seconds
 Removing buildable spots from on top of house level 4, foreground tree layering fix in level 5, and buildable spots added in level 9
